before.requirement: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start whose tag has a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 attribute value.
before.reason: The before scanner accepts a valid UTF-8 sequence in a quoted attribute value and can return 7 after the completed tag and newline. The harness can pass those Markdown bytes to document parsing.

after.requirement: Recognize the same type 7 HTML block start under the changed scanner.
after.reason: The after scanner's quoted-value byte map accepts the UTF-8 bytes, and its completed-tag path can return 7. The same harness input reaches document parsing.
